test=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in """6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6

6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6""".split('\n')]

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=6  # background color
    # find complete rectangle outlines of non-bg color; fill interior bg cells with 4
    from itertools import product
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # candidate rectangles: bounding boxes of connected non-bg structure; test all r1<r2,c1<c2 where border all non-bg
    import itertools
    rows=range(h); cols=range(w)
    for r1,r2 in itertools.combinations(rows,2):
        for c1,c2 in itertools.combinations(cols,2):
            ok=all(g[r1][c]!=bg for c in range(c1,c2+1)) and all(g[r2][c]!=bg for c in range(c1,c2+1)) \
               and all(g[r][c1]!=bg for r in range(r1,r2+1)) and all(g[r][c2]!=bg for r in range(r1,r2+1))
            if ok and (r2-r1>=2 and c2-c1>=2):
                # interior: cells strictly inside that are bg and enclosed (not reachable from outside through bg)
                for r in range(r1+1,r2):
                    for c in range(c1+1,c2):
                        if g[r][c]==bg:
                            out[r][c]=4
    return out
